_comment: Input for scripts/structured-data.mjs. Delete the keys that do not apply rather than leaving empty strings — an empty property is worse than an absent one. Every URL may be relative to "site"; the script makes it absolute.
name: Business Name
description: One sentence saying what the business does, where, and since when. Reuse this exact sentence on the Google Business Profile and in every directory listing.
_comment_address: For a business customers can visit, fill street and postalCode. For a business that travels to the customer, omit them, set "hideAddress": true, and rely on serviceArea.
_comment_geo: At least five decimal places. Take them from the Google Business Profile pin, not from a city-level lookup.
_comment_sameAs: Google Business Profile URL first, then social accounts and directory listings you control. This is what tells a machine that all these accounts are the same entity. Leave the array empty until the profiles actually exist.

services.name: Service name as a customer would say it
